steps.label: wuState
steps.js: (function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; var cam=e.engine.camera.instance; var wu=window.__labWuMesh; if(!wu) return 'no-wu'; var p=wu.position.clone(); p.project(cam); var sx=(p.x*0.5+0.5)*1280, sy=(-p.y*0.5+0.5)*720; return JSON.stringify({vis:wu.visible, pos:[+wu.position.x.toFixed(2),+wu.position.y.toFixed(2),+wu.position.z.toFixed(2)], screen:[Math.round(sx),Math.round(sy)], ndcZ:+p.z.toFixed(3), scale:[+wu.scale.x.toFixed(2),+wu.scale.y.toFixed(2)], hidden:(window.__labMoved||[]).filter(function(x){return String(x).indexOf('hide')>=0;}).length}); } catch(err){ return String(err); } })()

initScript: setInterval(function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; if(e&&e.revealMesh){ e.revealMesh.visible=false; } } catch(err){} }, 50);
